chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
content.stem: 在金融行动特别工作组(FATF)用于评估各司法管辖区反洗钱控制质量的相互评估及后续跟进过程中,FATF:

options.A: 对反洗钱控制措施不力的司法管辖区实施经济制裁,以迫使它们加强控制.
options.B: 对反洗钱控制措施薄弱的司法管辖区的金融机构进行现场检查,以发现不足之处并提出改进建议.
options.C: 每年发布报告,根据各成员管辖区对自身反洗钱控制措施的评估对其排名.
options.D: 开展同行评审程序,成员国据此评估其他司法管辖区的反洗钱控制措施,并提出改进建议.

content.stem_en: In the process of mutual evaluations and subsequent follow-ups used by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) to assess the quality of various jurisdictions' AML controls, the FATF:

options_en.A: Imposes economic sanctions on jurisdictions with lax AML controls to force them to strengthen their controls
options_en.B: Conducts on-site inspections of financial institutions in jurisdictions with lax AML controls to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements
options_en.C: Publishes annual reports ranking all member jurisdictions based on their self-assessment of AML controls
options_en.D: Conducts a peer review process whereby member countries assess the AML controls of other jurisdictions and recommend improvements
